categories.main_business_segments: Sekisui Jushi Corporation operates two main business segments: the Public Sector and the Private Sector. The Public Sector focuses on products and services for public infrastructure, such as noise barriers, traffic safety products, road markings, signage, guardrails, artificial turf, and park equipment. The Private Sector covers products for private markets, including mesh fences, soundproof walls, handrails, packaging materials, agricultural supplies, composite panels, exterior products, and digital picking systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages composite material technologies, advanced resin processing, and surface treatment techniques. It emphasizes the development of durable, recyclable, and environmentally friendly materials, as well as IoT and digital solutions for infrastructure and logistics. Manufacturing is primarily based on extrusion, molding, and assembly processes, with ongoing R&D in noise reduction, recycling, and smart infrastructure technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, municipalities, construction companies, logistics providers, manufacturers, agricultural businesses, and facility operators. The company serves public infrastructure projects (roads, railways, parks), residential and commercial construction, logistics and packaging, agriculture, and automotive-related industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: Sekisui Jushi has a strong presence in Japan and operates globally with subsidiaries and affiliates in Europe (notably Germany and the Netherlands), China, Southeast Asia (Thailand, Philippines), and other regions. The majority of sales are in Japan, but overseas sales, especially in Europe and Asia, are growing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream manufacturer, supplying finished and semi-finished products for infrastructure, construction, logistics, and agriculture. It integrates upstream raw materials (resins, metals) into value-added products and systems delivered to end-users and contractors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maximizing human capital, expanding growth areas (new domains, overseas business), and promoting sustainability. R&D focuses on advanced noise reduction, recycling technologies, smart infrastructure (IoT, digitalization), and products supporting decarbonization and circular economy. The company is also investing in next-generation traffic safety and automation technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured products, materials, and systems, as well as construction and installation services. Some business lines include recurring sales of consumables (e.g., packaging materials) and maintenance services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other Japanese and international manufacturers of infrastructure materials, construction products, and packaging solutions, such as Nippon Steel, Yodogawa Steel Works, and other resin and metal product companies. Sekisui Jushi positions itself as a leading provider of composite technology-based solutions with a strong reputation in both public and private sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated net sales reached 74.2 billion yen, with a workforce of 1,609 employees. While sales grew 18.2% year-on-year, operating and net profits declined due to increased costs and strategic investments. The company has a stable asset base (total assets: 139.3 billion yen) and continues to pursue steady, sustainable growth, with a focus on improving profitability and capital efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sekisui Jushi emphasizes the creation of value-added products through composite technologies, offering solutions that enhance safety, security, and environmental sustainability. Its differentiation lies in its ability to provide integrated, innovative, and durable products tailored to both public infrastructure and private sector needs, with a strong focus on sustainability, design, and advanced functionality.
